name: Reef Shark
appearanceEvidence: Both printings give an adult length of 6 to 10 ft. The Monster Manual also distinguishes its size from larger sharks. The black-tipped fins, slate back, pale belly, and slimmer blacktip reef shark anatomy are an editorial choice for the portrait.
habitatEvidence: The creature’s printed description identifies shallow water and coral reefs.
sourceDistinctions: The encounter statistics match the other scoped printing. The official Monster Manual errata lists no change for this creature.
